profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer with a design-thinking mindset and a systems-optimization approach to solving complex problems.

I love puzzles. That’s how I began my career as a Product Test Engineer, designing test circuitry for semiconductor development.

But then, I made an unexpected pivot into organizational psychology, captivated by the puzzle of human systems. I loved it!

For the past decade, I’ve supported the collaborative cultures of talented creative teams—engineers and designers—coming together to solve complex problems and build something amazing. And that made me want to tinker again.

Today, I’m passionate about building digital products that make life easier—for users and for engineers alike.

In my spare time, I still work on puzzles—like assembling complex toys for toddlers that come with minimal instructions or optimizing the dishwasher content placement for maximum load!

positions.title: Software Engineer, Co-Creator
positions.description:
Developed open-source framework to accelerate CI/CD build times for GitHub Actions workflows by automating AWS self-hosted runner deployment with persistent cache storage
(Technologies: Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, AWS SDK, Bash, YAML)

• Designed a VM architecture to provision ephemeral runner servers in an isolated VPC, providing users with a clean runtime environment while ensuring data security

• Created an optimized cache algorithm for npm install, caching the entire node_modules folder to minimize redundant dependency installations and achieving up to a 90% reduction in installation time

• Implemented the on-demand deployment of pre-configured AWS EC2 instances as GitHub Actions runners, utilizing a “warm pool” strategy to decrease boot-up time by over 50% and minimize workflow latency

• Simplified the setup experience by providing a single YAML file that stands up the Harrier infrastructure within the user’s own AWS account with minimal user effort

• Authored comprehensive case study (harrier-gha-runner.github.io/case-study) providing in-depth insight into Harrier’s use context, systems design, and engineering decisions

• Collaborated remotely across 3 time zones using agile workflow and Git best practices
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GitHub Actions · TypeScript · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed various personal and open-source web applications – highlights include:

• InspectHook – Tool for inspecting webhooks and HTTP requests to aid integration efforts
(Technologies: JavaScript, Node.js, Express, React, Nginx, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, VPS)

• StudentSync – Web application for online instructors to manage student meetings
(Technologies: Ruby, Sinatra, Rack, WEBrick, PostgreSQL)

• JobsearchMate – Job search tool to manage network outreach and application status
(Technologies: TypeScript, Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon DynamoDB)
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · MongoDB · JavaScript · Ruby · Web Development

positions.title: Insights and Strategy
positions.description:
Humanized organizational transformations by leveraging the power of Story and Narrative to create connections between organizational missions and their team members, leading to scalable and sustainable impact

• Articulated user journey maps to identify priority focus points for programmatic interventions

• Designed written and visual communication artifacts to support project documentation and stakeholder engagement
positions.insights: Skills: User Journeys · Presentation Skills · Insight Generation · Storytelling

positions.title: Learning & Organizational Development
positions.description:
Designed organizational systems for key clients that enhanced employee experience and culture, leading to optimal execution of company mission and strategy

• Facilitated strategic planning sessions of nonprofits, engaging both board members and the leadership team

• Conducted interviews, focus groups, surveys, and assessments to deliver data-driven organizational intervention plans
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Project Management · Strategic Planning · Stakeholder Engagement

positions.title: Consultant - Data Engineer / Research Analyst
positions.description:
Conducted program research and evaluation for a community college district with annual
enrollment of 60,000+ students
(Technologies: Oracle SQL Developer, PL/SQL, MS Access)

• Create custom denormalized views and materialized views within Ellucian’s operational data store to support the institutional research data needs

• Program ad hoc functions to assist with the data analysis necessary for understanding effectiveness of program interventions on student success

• Conduct complex data queries and develop easy-to-understand data sets that capture student behavior insights to promote effective and efficient decision making
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Relational Databases · Operational Data Store (ODS) · Institutional Research · Microsoft Access

positions.title: Learning and Development
positions.description:
Developed and managed programs related to onboarding, professional development, and company culture

• Supported team building to foster engagement while protecting the mental and emotional well-being of team members

• Delivered professional development workshops with the intentional incorporation of “play” as a source of inspiration
positions.insights: Skills: Employee Learning & Development · Facilitation · MBTI · Organizational Culture · Employee Engagement

positions.title: Human-Centered Design
positions.description:
Managed daily operations of the Graduate Industrial Design department, with a focus on teaching human-centric business strategies

• Coached students on balancing business viability, technical feasibility, and user desirability within their design solutions

• Oversaw operations of a nationally ranked graduate program with a $1M annual budget
positions.insights: Skills: Design Thinking · Program Management · Business Strategy · Coaching & Mentoring
